title: OSF UI
description: OSF UI behavior and overlay presentation.

settings.label: Open / Close key
settings.hint: Press to rebind the key that opens and closes the overlay.

settings.label: Language
settings.hint: Use auto for Starfield's language, or enter a locale such as en, de, or pt-BR.

settings.label: 240 Hz focused capture
settings.hint: Allow focused menus to request capture at up to 240 Hz. May increase GPU use.

settings.label: Developer mode
settings.hint: Enable verbose diagnostics, F12 WebView DevTools, schema and loose-view hot reload, and developer-only views on the next launch. Security and validation rules remain unchanged.
